slides.title: Manufacturing Industry Context
slides.task_brief: Industry context slide. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT · MANUFACTURING' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'Manufacturing is converging physical operations with digital intelligence.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Connected operations, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility and quality at scale define the modern factory.'. Below subtitle: a TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT column (55% width): a .surface-elev panel (~560px x 360px) titled 'WHY MANUFACTURING NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow in --brand). Below, a stacked list of 4 industry drivers, each as a small .surface card with: Material Icon (20px) in --brand + Sora 600 driver title (13px) + Inter 11px --text-secondary description. Verbatim drivers — 'precision_manufacturing' 'Industry 4.0 convergence' / 'OT/IT convergence accelerating — ISA-95, OPC UA, MTConnect connecting factory floor to cloud.' 'shield' 'IEC 62443 cybersecurity mandate' / 'OT security now regulated — IEC 62443-3-3 SL2 compliance required for connected factories.' 'speed' 'OEE optimisation pressure' / 'Overall Equipment Effectiveness targets rising — predictive maintenance and real-time quality data now baseline.' 'local_shipping' 'Supply chain resilience' / 'Multi-echelon visibility, supplier risk monitoring, and demand forecasting now critical for continuity.' RIGHT column (45% width): a .surface-elev panel (~440px x 360px) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR QUALITY & SECURITY ENGINEERING' (eyebrow in --accent-dark). Below body: a small .tag-pill 'OT-AWARE · ISA-95 ALIGNED · IEC 62443' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left `KEFI TECH`; center '02 / 12'; right 'MANUFACTURING CONTEXT'.

We work with Siemens Opcenter, SAP S/4HANA, AWS IoT SiteWise, Ignition SCADA, and NVIDIA Jetson edge — not generic platforms. Every sub-service below is aligned to ISA-95 hierarchy and IEC 62443 security.' Below body: a small .tag-pill 'CAPABILITY 1 OF 6 · MANUFACTURING' in --brand-soft. Verbatim sub-services (DEEP-TECH with real platform names): 1 'security' 'SAST for Industrial Codebases (OT-Aware)' / 'Static analysis tuned for OT code — PLC logic (Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA scripts (Ignition), MES APIs — per IEC 62443-4-1.' 2 'security' 'DAST for MES & SCADA Web Interfaces' / 'Dynamic testing of Ignition Perspective, Siemens Opcenter web UIs — OWASP Top 10 + ICS-specific (CWE-1214 ICS).' 3 'security' 'Secure Code Review for PLC/SCADA' / 'Manual review of PLC ladder logic (IEC 61131-3) and SCADA scripts — injection, authentication bypass, unsafe states.' 4 'security' 'CI/CD Security Gates for Industrial Software' / 'GitLab CI pipeline with SAST (SonarQube), SCA (Snyk), secrets scanning, and IEC 62443 compliance checks.' 5 'security' 'ICS Vulnerability Scanning (Claroty / Nozomi)' / 'Continuous passive scanning of OT network via Claroty xDome / Nozomi Guardian — ICS CVE detection without disruption.'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture (OT/IT)', 'IEC 62443 security design', 'Platform selection', 'Build plan'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services (OT-aware)', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'.
